description: The recursive definition clause list equals concatenation of the gate lists over the subformula list, in occurrence order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.definitions_flatMap.{u} {α : Type u}
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.definitions A =
    List.flatMap Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.gate
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.subformulas A)
